title: NAILS deactivate --json
description: Machine-readable deactivate envelope (contract version 2): exactly one document on stdout with schema_version, command, ok, and either data or error. It reports the outcome: a success is printed only once the soft-reboot back to the decoy (or the power-off) is enqueued, so a failure to prepare or enqueue it is the one document (ok false, exit 1) and never follows a success. The switch then stops every program of the hidden session, the reader included, so a reader stopped first may not read the success. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9. A declined prompt, or Ctrl+C at it, is the shared cancel shape: an error with the code `cancelled`, no data, exit 130; once the way back has begun, a signal no longer stops it. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.
